step1_analysis.description: A fully differential two-stage op-amp with an auxiliary feedforward or common-mode extraction path. The first and second stages are NMOS differential pairs with PMOS active loads.

paper_reference.title: Adaptive Cancellation of Gain and Nonlinearity Errors in Pipelined ADCs

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm1*(ro1||ro2) * gm2*(ro3||ro4). With Id~50uA, gm~0.5mA/V, ro~180kOhm, stage gain is ~34dB. Total gain ~68dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for SKY130 1.8V devices. The paper reports multiple gain values likely for different amplifier configurations in the pipeline ADC.

sky130_expected.calculation: UGF = gm1 / (2*pi*Cc). With gm1=0.54mA/V and assumed Cc=1pF, UGF = 86MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the paper's reported frequency range. Requires assumed 1pF Miller compensation for stability.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the non-dominant pole at the output. P2 = gm2 / (2*pi*Cload). With Cload=6pF, P2 is high enough to provide >45 deg margin.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard requirement for closed-loop stability in pipeline ADCs.
Based on typical bias currents for 5u/0.5u devices in SKY130.

sky130_expected.calculation: CMRR = A_diff - A_cm. A_cm is attenuated by the tail current source output impedance.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Fully differential architecture provides excellent CMRR.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for measuring differential AC gain, unity gain frequency, phase margin, common-mode gain, and power consumption. Includes ideal CMFB and assumed Miller compensation.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Fully Differential Two-Stage Op-Amp Testbench
.lib "sky130_fd_pr/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

* Parameters
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u
.param W_xm15=5u L_xm15=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N6 N2 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N12 LABEL_NET_0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N1 N0 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N3 N6 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM6 N0 N4 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM5 N11 N4 N12 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM7 N9 N2 N12 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N1 N13 N10 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N5 LABEL_NET_1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N0 N14 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N7 LABEL_NET_2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N8 LABEL_NET_3 N11 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 N8 LABEL_NET_3 N9 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM14 N6 N14 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}
XM15 N3 N13 N10 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm15} w={W_xm15}

* Power Supplies
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VN10 N10 0 1.8
VN8 N8 0 1.8

* Bias Voltages
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.6
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.6
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 0.6
VLABEL_NET_3 LABEL_NET_3 0 1.0

* Ideal CMFB for PMOS loads
B1 N14 0 V='1.2 + (v(N6) + v(N0) - 1.8)*10'
B2 N13 0 V='1.2 + (v(N3) + v(N1) - 1.8)*10'

* Input Sources
VCM VCM 0 0.9
VD INP_AC 0 dc 0 ac 1
E1 N2 VCM INP_AC 0 0.5
E2 N4 VCM INP_AC 0 -0.5

* Compensation Capacitors (Added for stability)
Cc1 N6 N3 1p
Cc2 N0 N1 1p

* Load Capacitors (From paper: 6pF)
C1 N3 0 6p
C2 N1 0 6p

* Differential Output Extraction
E_diff out_diff 0 vol='v(N3) - v(N1)'

.control
op
print v(N6) v(N0) v(N3) v(N1) v(N14) v(N13)

* Differential AC Analysis
ac dec 100 1 1G
let gain_db = vdb(out_diff)
let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(out_diff))
let pm = phase + 180

meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
meas ac ugf when gain_db=0 fall=1
meas ac phase_margin find pm when gain_db=0 fall=1

* Common Mode AC Analysis
alter VD ac=0
alter VCM ac=1
ac dec 100 1 1G
let cm_gain_db = vdb(out_diff)
meas ac cm_gain find cm_gain_db at=10

* Power Calculation
op
let power = -(i(VVDD) + i(VN10) + i(VN8)) * 1.8
print power
.endc
.end
